title: MEIKO — Feeling What My Selves Feel〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Another day, and still so many feelings to see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I sense even stronger feelings than ever coming from their SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure that's thanks to their efforts, plus the support of each version of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I wonder how that version of me I met is doing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd love to have a chat like that with the other versions of me too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me...
Some SEKAI have changed through the power of the feelings that form them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I haven't seen yet, so I'll go take a little peek, and see how those versions of me are doing while I'm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The feelings are suddenly getting so powerful...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I definitely wasn't expecting the floating fragments of feelings to rush in and push me around like that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's no doubt that this is a fragment SEKAI. I must have touched a fragment just now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd kind of feel bad looking in on someone's feelings under this circumstance, so I suppose I'll just wait a...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What was that...?
It felt like someone was calling out to me just now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, there's something glowing over there.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Maybe I'll go take a quick look.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, these must be the source of the glow!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Photos...? I'm not sure that's quite right, but anyway, the SEKAI versions of us are in them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me in a band, me as an idol... As a cafe owner, as a member of an acting troupe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, and there's the one I met before!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also... I sense powerful feelings in these photos, or whatever they are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
MEIKO, there's a little thread on your shoulder.
Here, I'll get it for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
...
I'm perfectly capable of doing that myself.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You are? Well, it's on your left shoulder.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehehe. Your cheeks are softer than I expected, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you think you're doing?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
What do you mean? I'm toying with you.
I was so very bored.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
...
I'd appreciate it if you wouldn't use others for your own enjoyment.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
...
It looks like my hunch was right, and each of these is made from the feelings of our SEKAI selves.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This could very well be a fragment SEKAI born from their feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It was so cute to see that version of me getting teased by Luka.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've been watching over them all this time, so I can't believe I was missing out on that endearing side of her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know. I think I'll take this chance to get in touch with the feelings of my other versions as well.
